items.reason: Formal nominalization duplicates the practical beginner verb 歩く and is not needed for basic movement/transport communication.
Technical/formal movement noun is too specialized for Bab 5 and adds little beyond core transport verbs.
Specialist station role is low-frequency for the beginner transport objective.
Overlaps strongly with 交通機関 while adding a more abstract compound at a very early stage.

Same lexical item 電話番号 is already introduced in Bab 1. The Bab 7 row exists only because Bab 1 had a shortened/incorrect reading; keep the Bab 1 UUID and deprecate this duplicate row in the next gate.
Near-redundant with 苦手 and 下手 in the same beginner skills chapter; increases synonym load without clear communicative gain.
Highly polysemous/nuanced for a beginner chapter and not needed for the core likes/ability/reason objectives.
Low-frequency specialist place noun overlaps with 会館 and is not needed for basic existence/location practice.
Same lexical verb was already introduced in Bab 1 as the fixed response 違います; keeping a second item only for conjugation violates one-lexeme/one-UUID policy.

Transparent compositional phrase (写真 + を + 撮る), while 撮る was already introduced as a lexical verb in Bab 6. Keeping this as a separate Vocabulary item would duplicate lexical content and exposes dictionary form before Bab 18.
More literary/general than needed and overlaps the clearer practical term 旅行者 in the same travel chapter.
